methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 8 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Prusa Research is a bootstrapped frontier-tech company operating in Robotics & Manufacturing, founded by Josef Průša. The available comp universe consists of 1 public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private peers in the robotics and manufacturing sector, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Bedrock Robotics, and Dexterity.

The peer-median valuation method is not applicable to this analysis. The target company operates at a bootstrapped stage with no institutional capital raised, which does not yield a sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peer set within Robotics & Manufacturing. While 8 same-sector peers exist, none meet the narrow filters required for meaningful triangulation—specifically, no peers matched on stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier simultaneously. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material distortion and is therefore rejected.

Without a sufficient peer cluster meeting methodological thresholds, this analysis cannot support a quantitative valuation range based on the data provided. To proceed, additional methods—such as revenue or EBITDA multiples applied to target financials, discounted cash flow analysis, or expansion of the comp set to include earlier-stage institutional investors—would be required. The primary uncertainty remains the lack of tight-fit comparable companies at the bootstrapped stage within the robotics sector.
